fields.Name: T220 - User Access Domain Group Expand Collapse
fields.Description: Exercises the mj-accordion-panel expand/collapse (onGroupExpandedChange) and the per-domain grouped NormalizedPermission table render (groupPermissionsByDomain output). This accordion-of-tables layout is unique to this surface and separate from the user-selection path.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the Permissions app via the application switcher next to the logo and stay on the 'User Access' tab; if no domains show for the pre-selected user, pick a user in the 'User:' dropdown who has permissions (an admin user is a good bet). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Find a collapsible domain accordion panel (each shows a domain name with an icon and a numeric count badge on the right) and click its header to expand it. Success is that expanding reveals a permissions table with columns Resource, Type, Actions, and Effect (Allow/Deny badges), and clicking the header again collapses it. If the selected user genuinely has zero permissions, seeing the 'No permissions' empty-state is an acceptable success instead.

judgeValidationCriteria: A domain accordion panel with a name, icon, and count badge is visible
Clicking the panel header expands it to show a permissions table (Resource / Type / Actions / Effect columns), and it can be collapsed again — OR a valid 'No permissions' empty-state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
